TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_Guards.en: The beast does not stir.\nIts guardians still stand watch.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_Guards.fr: La bête ne bouge pas.\nSes gardiens veillent toujours.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T0Intr.en: The EMBER hall is closed to\nstrangers.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T0Intr.fr: La salle de BRAISE est fermée aux\nétrangers.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T0Post.en: Deeper in, the heat is worse.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T0Post.fr: Plus profond, la chaleur est pire.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T1Intr.en: Our flame never dies, and neither\ndo we!
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T1Intr.fr: Notre flamme ne s'éteint jamais, et\nnous non plus !

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T1Post.en: The ORACLE keeps the last room.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T2Intr.en: The beast gave us warmth when\nthe sky turned cold.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T2Intr.fr: La bête nous a donné de la chaleur\nquand le ciel s'est refroidi.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T2Post.en: Mind the lava. It is hungry.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T2Post.fr: Attention à la lave. Elle a faim.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T3Defe.fr: Il ne reste que des cendres.

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T3Intr.en: You smell of rain. Leave, or\nburn!
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T3Intr.fr: Tu sens la pluie. Pars, ou brûle !

TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T4Intr.en: I am the ORACLE of the EMBER.\nThe beast sleeps in my care.\pProve that your fire is worth\nmore than my fear.
TwoIsland_CapeBrink_EmberDen_Text_T4Intr.fr: Je suis l'ORACLE de la BRAISE.\nLa bête dort sous ma garde.\pProuve que ton feu vaut plus que\nma peur.
